blockedBy: Disabled together with 04-feedback-relay: FeedbackClient.IssueUrl is only used to validate relay receipts, and tests/FeedbackFormTests.cs hardcodes the upstream issue URL. Keep the feedback subsystem untouched.
rationale: FeedbackClient.IsIssueUrl validates relay receipts against this base. Even with the relay disabled, keeping it pointed at upstream would be misleading if the relay is ever re-enabled.
compliance: Pure URL substitution; no upstream copyright or attribution is removed.
